description: This file contains utility functions for exporting data as CSV, managing query suggestions, and handling query tokens in a usage query interface within a UI project.

methods.name: downloadTextFile
methods.description: Creates and triggers download of a text file with specified content and filename.

methods.name: csvEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for CSV format, wrapping in quotes if necessary.

methods.name: toCsvRow
methods.description: Converts an array of values to a CSV-formatted string.

methods.name: buildSessionsCsv
methods.description: Generates CSV string from an array of UsageSessionEntry objects.

methods.name: buildDailyCsv
methods.description: Generates CSV string from an array of CostDailyEntry objects.

methods.name: buildQuerySuggestions
methods.description: Provides query suggestions based on current input, sessions, and aggregates.

methods.name: applySuggestionToQuery
methods.description: Replaces the last token in a query with a suggestion.

methods.name: normalizeQueryText
methods.description: Normalizes query text by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: addQueryToken
methods.description: Adds a token to the query, replacing existing token if key matches.

methods.name: removeQueryToken
methods.description: Removes a specific token from the query.

methods.name: setQueryTokensForKey
methods.description: Sets multiple tokens for a specific key in the query.
